name: taskpe
description: TaskPe has no JavaScript build step: public/js/app.js and public/css/app.css are the sources and are served as written. This file exists so `npm run test:js` works, and so `npm run dev` / `npm run build` say that out loud instead of failing inside a bundler that was never configured. The only npm users here are the Shopify Admin extensions, and Shopify CLI builds those (shopify app build) from the extensions/ folders.

scripts.dev: node -e "console.error('No bundler in this project. App dev: php artisan serve (or composer dev). Admin extensions: shopify app dev, which builds them itself.')" && exit 1
scripts.build: node -e "console.error('Nothing to build. public/js/app.js + public/css/app.css are committed as-is; extensions are built by Shopify CLI (shopify app build).')" && exit 1
